goal: Import the Phase 3E prepared transparent world-facing assets into the Godot project, reference them from the existing platformer scene, and verify the scene loads and smoke-tests without changing gameplay logic.
forbidden_changes: movement changes, collision changes, HUD implementation, enemy, item, scoring, camera, web export, or gameplay expansion
final art direction, style bible, production asset approval, or public-release asset usage
Working, Canonical, or Policy Learning Card promotion

verify.name: Imported asset files exist
verify.command: test -e game/assets/phase3e/player.png && test -e game/assets/phase3e/player.png.import && test -e game/assets/phase3e/floor_platform.png && test -e game/assets/phase3e/floor_platform.png.import && test -e game/assets/phase3e/obstacle.png && test -e game/assets/phase3e/obstacle.png.import && test -e game/assets/phase3e/goal_marker.png && test -e game/assets/phase3e/goal_marker.png.import

human_decision_reason: BK/Human Creative Owner must review whether the imported prototype art result is acceptable for the Phase 3 capability gate. This Work Package only proves technical loading and smoke-test viability.
acceptance_criteria: The prepared player, floor/platform, obstacle, and goal marker assets are copied into game/assets/phase3e.
Godot import metadata is generated for each copied PNG.
main.tscn references the prototype assets with Sprite2D/Texture2D while preserving existing collision and gameplay logic.
Smoke test and main scene headless run pass with no SCRIPT ERROR or ERROR output.
The implementation note records the initial import failure, recovery via godot --import, verification, and remaining visual/collision risks.
No final art, production use, gameplay expansion, or broader asset-pack scope is approved.
notes: This Work Package performs the Phase 3F Godot import prototype test. It proves technical viability of using prepared transparent assets in the Godot scene and stops before QA/human creative approval.
